description: Indicative timeline for developing a wellness product in Australia, from the records and the stages on takefridayoff.com/guides/supplement-development-timeline: what comparable products took (design to production order, or signed brief to dispatch), the six stages a listed medicine is built in, and which of the known hold-ups apply to this product (a new ingredient and the TGA's evaluation windows, a pathway not yet settled, a formula not yet proven, an overseas factory). Every figure is quoted from the page with its link. Not a quote or a promise for a particular product.

clock.description: Which measure to give: design_to_production_order (the formula to the first production order) or brief_to_dispatch (the signed brief to the first batch leaving for the 3PL, manufacturing included; the default)

formula_proven.description: The formula has already been proven in samples and trials (it runs on the line, tastes right, is stable)

made_overseas.description: The product will be made outside Australia (the site then needs a TGA GMP clearance)

new_ingredient.description: An ingredient that is not yet on the TGA's Permissible Ingredients Determination, so it needs its own evaluation first

pathway.description: listed_medicine (a TGA-listed medicine), food, cosmetic, or unknown (not settled yet; tfo_pathway_check can help)

product.description: The product in a sentence: "magnesium capsule for sleep", "probiotic powder in sachets"

name: tfo_timeline
title: How long will it take?
